intro.text: A skaa pewter Misting in Kelsier's crew, who helps organize the rebellion's army of skaa.
A pewter Misting from Kelsier's old crew, now captain of Elend Venture's guard and one of his advisors.
A pewter Misting from Kelsier's old crew who trains and leads Elend Venture's army in its campaign against Fadrex City.

items.text: Ham grew up on the streets of Luthadel, the son of two skaa parents, and made his living running security for thieving crews, supplying crewleaders with muscle and fighters when a job called for them.

Ham joined Kelsier's plan against the Lord Ruler, at first for the pay Yeden promised, including the Lord Ruler's atium. As General Hammond he trained the skaa army in hidden caves away from Luthadel, leaving the crew for months at a time to drill and inspect the recruits, until Yeden took over the camps and Ham was sent back to work with Kelsier.

Ham taught Vin to burn pewter and the two became friends. She went with him to meet contacts in Luthadel's Garrison, where they learned the rebel army had been discovered and soldiers were marching against it. The Garrison asked Ham to join them, and Kelsier wanted him inside, but Ham refused to betray them from within.

The Garrison killed Yeden and scattered most of the army, and the crew was ready to quit until Kelsier, seeing the Lord Ruler execute skaa in reprisal, rallied them to strike at Luthadel while the Garrison was away. Ham brought the surviving troops into the city and kept recruiting, training them in small groups that didn't know about each other.
When Lord Renoux, his household and Spook were captured, Ham fetched a team of rebels and led the attack that freed every prisoner while Kelsier fought a Steel Inquisitor.

Kelsier left instructions for a final assault, with Clubs in command and Ham charged with taking down the remaining noble houses, bringing in the army and seizing warehouses. Ham brought down Keep Elariel and kept fighting until the end.

After the Lord Ruler's death, Ham agreed to captain Elend's guard on condition that he never had to wear a uniform. With the rest of Kelsier's crew he advised Elend through the siege by Straff's and Cett's armies, staying level-headed even as a koloss army approached.

Loyal to Elend, Ham tried to help him research legal ways to keep his throne, though he was no scholar, and stood by him after he lost it. When the city's fall seemed certain, he met in secret with Breeze, Dockson, Sazed and the rest of the crew, and they chose to stay and fight while sending Vin, Elend, Spook, Tindwyl and Allrianne away to safety.

When the koloss attacked, Ham led the defence of a keep, but it fell and he was badly wounded. On Vin's return he gave her his pewter before passing out, waking to find the city saved. He then helped Sazed, who had fought Marsh, and helped organize the Lord Ruler's storage cache in Luthadel.
Ham remained part of Elend's inner circle, suggesting ways to grow plants that needed no light and joining the plans to take Fadrex City.

He trained and led the new army for the siege of Fadrex. Attached to his men, he argued constantly with Elend and Vin against marching through the mists while soldiers were dying to them, but he followed orders, holding the siege and cutting off supplies while Elend tried diplomacy and searched for the city's hidden storage cache.

Ham shared command of the Mistings with Demoux until Demoux was sent to Luthadel, then kept the army together while Vin was taken and Elend went to capture koloss. He persuaded Elend not to unleash the koloss on the city and obeyed his order to retreat.
Ham fought at Fadrex City and set out to join the fight in Luthadel. He survived the end of the crisis and was finally reunited with his family.

Little is known of Hammond's life afterwards, but in Elendel Hammondar Bay, the Hammond Promenade and the month of Hammondar carry his name. He wrote a book, the Testimony of Hammond, and House Hammondess traces its founding to him or one of his children.

appearance.text: Ham keeps his hair very short and usually wears a loose sleeveless shirt and vest. As General Hammond he had to wear a uniform, which he disliked, and he made giving it up a condition of serving Elend.

personality.text: Humble, kindly and long-winded, Ham loves philosophical debate, wondering aloud whether overthrowing a god is truly good and arguing over atium economics. He cares deeply for his crew and soldiers and wants to be sure there is a bigger plan for them.

His musings led him to notice that skaa seem made differently from nobles, in how many children they have and even in their height. Kelsier finds him prone to thoughts no sane man would consider, yet listens, and never forgot that debate.

Ham usually seems content. He works to give his family a better life and dreams of moving with them to a city where they can live like nobles, without fear or division. He is loyal to Kelsier but worried by his ego, and tries with Dockson and Breeze to rein him in.

Ham's wife, Mardra, is a seamstress who lives outside the city and tells people her husband works in the Garrison. He keeps her away from his work to protect her and misses her, seeing her only a couple of months a year. They have two children.

As a general he is something of an anarchist at heart, but he leads a small team very well, promoting good-natured people. His guards are not the most polished soldiers, but they are fiercely loyal to him.
